definitions.explanation: The seeds of the coffee plant, used to brew coffee. Refers to both roasted and unroasted beans.

examples.japanese: コーヒー{豆|まめ}を{挽|ひ}く。
この{店|みせ}では{新鮮|しんせん}なコーヒー{豆|まめ}を{売|う}っている。
examples.english: This shop sells fresh coffee beans.

examples.japanese: ブラジル{産|さん}のコーヒー{豆|まめ}は{酸味|さんみ}が{少|すく}なくて{飲|の}みやすい。
examples.english: Brazilian coffee beans have low acidity and are easy to drink.

examples.japanese: {自家焙煎|じかばいせん}のコーヒー{豆|まめ}を{通販|つうはん}で{注文|ちゅうもん}した。
examples.english: I ordered home-roasted coffee beans through mail order.

notes:
A compound of コーヒー (coffee) and {豆|まめ} (bean). Japan has a strong coffee culture, and specialty coffee shops ({自家焙煎|じかばいせん}の{店|みせ}) that roast their own beans are common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- コーヒー{豆|まめ}を{挽|ひ}く: to grind coffee beans
- コーヒー{豆|まめ}を{焙煎|ばいせん}する: to roast coffee beans
- コーヒー{豆|まめ}の{産地|さんち}: coffee bean growing region
- {生|なま}のコーヒー{豆|まめ}: green (unroasted) coffee beans

RELATED WORDS:
- {焙煎|ばいせん}: roasting (of coffee)
- {挽|ひ}きたて: freshly ground
- ドリップコーヒー: drip coffee
- インスタントコーヒー: instant coffee
